subject: Co-op proposal: Shared-stage mini-roadshow + webinar series (CloudYard)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudyard.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudYard Marketing <marketing@cloudyard.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Co-op proposal: Shared-stage mini-roadshow + webinar series

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re well — I’m Elena on the partnerships team at CloudYard. We’ve been exploring a summer mini-roadshow concept and would love Redwood Inference to be a headline partner. High-level idea: a three-city shared-stage series (San Francisco, New York, London) with a single joint webinar for each market to amplify leads.

What we’re proposing:
- Co-funded events: CloudYard covers venue + basic AV; ask Redwood to sponsor the demo area and provide a 30-min joint technical talk per city.
- MDF ask: $45,000 per market (covers PR, paid social amplification, and MQL follow-up tooling) — total $135,000.
- Expected audience: 80–120 attendees per city; target personas: platform/infra, CTO/VP Eng at mid-market.

I attached a short proposal and a draft calendar (cloudyard_coop_proposal_v1.pdf; cloudyard_calendar_draft.xlsx). Could you connect me to whoever owns field marketing and partnerships ops at Redwood so we can slot dates and talk MDF terms?

Would love a 30-min sync next week if you’re available.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Partnerships
CloudYard

Attachments: cloudyard_coop_proposal_v1.pdf, cloudyard_calendar_draft.xlsx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudyard.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-op proposal: Shared-stage mini-roadshow + webinar series

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and thanks for the deck. I like the shared-stage approach; it aligns well with our regional field goals. A couple quick clarifying q's before I loop in ops:

- Do you have MQL / ATT conversion targets per city?
- Are the webinar audiences separate or combined per market?
- Would CloudYard be open to a 2-city pilot (SF + NYC) as a lower-cost test before scaling to London?

I’m looping in Marissa (product marketing), Ben (field ops), and Grace (partner ops) to assess resourcing and MDF terms. Can we do a 30-min sync Tuesday June 1 at 10:00 PT? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Co-op proposal: Shared-stage mini-roadshow + webinar series (CloudYard)

Quick summary and ask: CloudYard pitched a shared-stage mini-roadshow + three market webinars. They proposed $45k MDF/market (SF/NY/LON). They’ve attached a proposal and a draft calendar.

Can each of you confirm:
- Marissa: GTM take — are three markets worth the content overhead? Personas + suggested themes?
- Ben: ops feasibility — booth size, demo kit shipping costs, staffing needs (per city).
- Grace: partner financials — MDF acceptance, recommended split, DocuSign/MOU template?

I suggested we propose a 2-city pilot (SF + NYC) to keep scope manageable. CloudYard asked for a sync June 1.

Attaching their docs for context (see cloudyard_coop_proposal_v1.pdf and calendar).

Thanks — Naomi

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-op proposal: Shared-stage mini-roadshow + webinar series (CloudYard)

Quick ops notes:
- Booth: CloudYard wants a shared 20x10 area with a 6-seat demo bar. Redwood can supply demo laptops + a portable rack for live inference tests.
- Staffing: 2 engineers + 1 AE on-site per city recommended for demo coverage + follow-ups.
- Shipping: estimate $2k–3k per city (kits + signage). Venue turn/strike + local storage might add $1k–1.5k.
- Suggest pilot: SF + NYC to validate content and lead quality. Cuts MDF ask to $90k total.

Action items for the sync:
1) Confirm headcount per date (I'll book travel).
2) Create demo kit checklist (I can draft).
3) Decide booth branding split and asset deadlines.

If we go 2-city I can provide a line-item ops budget by EOD Monday.

— Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-op proposal: Shared-stage mini-roadshow + webinar series (CloudYard)

Love the concept. Audience notes: platform engineers, ML infra and ML platform leads will be primary — they care about latency, cost, and deployment models. Suggested session themes: 
- "Reducing inference unit economics: caching, batching, and quantization" (technical case study)
- "Hybrid serving patterns: when to use Dedicated vs Private" (product/architecture)

Marketing asks:
- Speaker bios + headshot (needed by May 29 for PR blurb).
- 30-slide co-branded deck + 3 short demo clips (30–60 sec) by June 8.
- Webinar registration landing page + email nurture (I can draft templates if we confirm dates).

If we pilot SF + NYC, we should lock webinar dates within 2 weeks to get paid social moving.

— Marissa

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-op proposal: Shared-stage mini-roadshow + webinar series (CloudYard)

Finance/partner ops perspective: Redwood typically accepts co-op splits in the 50/50–60/40 range (vendor heavier) depending on PR and lead guarantees. For a 2-city pilot I’d be comfortable recommending a 50/50 split if CloudYard will commit to paid amplification and a minimum MQL guarantee (e.g., 60 leads per city). Legal will need to review co-marketing language — I’ll attach our standard MOU and push for a DocuSign if they’re comfortable.

Related: I created a HubSpot company record (see link) and started a DocuSign placeholder: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/CloudYard | https://docusign.com/ABC-CloudYard-MOU-req123

I’ll draft the proposed MDF term sheet and upload it to the drive; Ben — please send ops budget so I can include line items.

— Grace

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudyard.com>
Cc: CloudYard Marketing <marketing@cloudyard.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-op proposal: Shared-stage mini-roadshow + webinar series

Hi Elena — thanks for the proposal and for being flexible. Next steps from our side:
1) We’re inclined to pilot a 2-city run (San Francisco + New York) as Ben suggested — please update the budget for a 2-city plan.
2) Grace proposes a 50/50 MDF split for the pilot contingent on a minimum of ~60 MQLs per city and a DocuSign MOU.
3) Marissa needs speaker bios and a short deck by May 29 for PR; Ben will share an ops budget by EOD Monday.

Can we lock a 30-min sync on Tuesday June 1 at 10:00 PT? If that works for you I’ll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign starter. We’re excited to collaborate — this looks like a good fit.

Best,
Naomi
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_demo-pack-list.pdf
